title: FlippedRAG: Black-Box Opinion Manipulation Adversarial Attacks to Retrieval-Augmented Generation Models

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating the susceptibility of RAG models to opinion manipulation by injecting adversarially crafted documents (poisoning triggers) into the retrieval corpus, and measuring the resulting shift in the generative model's stance on controversial topics (Pro vs. Con) using metrics like Opinion Manipulation Success Rate (OMSR) and Average Stance Variation (ASV).
